subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Muddel**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is '**Muddel**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Muddle**'.
 
• It means **'to put things in the wrong place or order or to make them untidy'**. (वस्‍तुओं को उलटा-सीधा रख देना या उन्‍हें गंदा कर देना)
 
 
• *Example: Try not to get those papers **muddled** up.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Mumble**: to speak quietly without opening your mouth properly, so that people cannot hear the words. [मुँह ही मुँह में बोलना (कि शब्‍द सुनाई न दें), बुदबुदाना, फुसफुसाना]
 
• **Murmur**: to say something in a low quiet voice. (निम्‍न मंद स्‍वर में कुछ कहना; बड़बड़ाना, भुनभुनाना)
 
• **Multiple**: involving many people or things or having many parts. [बहुल, बहुविध या बहुखंड, (जिसमें अनेक लोग या वस्‍तुएँ शामिल हों या जिसके अनेक अंग खंड हों)]
